text:
Jules Park: FYI marketplace reviewer for CloudHub asked for an escrow-friendly evidence package for our joint listing with NimbusSI. They want: KMS key handling statement, code-signing chain (public certs only), pen-test exec summary (no POC), and a signed indemnity for firmware escrow. cc @Sophie Tran @Dominic Yu :wave:
Sophie Tran: Who owns the indemnity? Are we being asked to indemnify the marketplace or the SI partner? Need clarity before legal drafts anything.
Marketplace-Reviewer: We require a limited indemnity from the publisher covering knowingly malicious firmware. This is standard for cloud catalog edge listings that allow partner-hosted runtimes. It can be a short clause attached to the attestation.
Dominic Yu: OK we can agree to a limited indemnity clause but not open-ended. Legal will need to draft and redline. Also: KMS statement 1 1 (what do they mean by "key escrow allowed?")
legal-sig: Clarify: marketplace wants confirmation that private keys used for code signing are held in a non-exportable HSM (no escrow) OR, if escrowed for marketplace verification, an explicit escrow process and escrow agent identity. They also requested the public cert chain and a signed note saying private keys do not leave HSM unless under escrow contract.
evidence-bot: Draft manifest created: items -> kms-statement.pdf (30d), code-signing-chain.pem (30d), pen-exec-summary.pdf (14d), indemnity-clause.pdf (90d). Manifest ID: ch-escrow-1912345555.
Sophie Tran: We should prefer "no escrow" and provide attestation that keys are non-exportable. If marketplace insists on escrow, propose using a vetted escrow agent and a sealed-process template.
Jules Park: NimbusSI prefers escrow to allow in-country verification. But they said they'd accept a notarized "no-escrow" attestation if marketplace will permit remote verification. Tradeoff: escrow increases legal complexity.
Dominic Yu: Ops note: code signing chain (public) is safe to share. For KMS attestation, infra can produce this snippet for the manifest:
```
KMS Provider: VaultHSM Inc.
HSM Model: VaultHSM-4
Key Type: RSA-3072
Key Usage: CodeSign (non-exportable)
Attestation: keys generated in HSM; private key non-exportable; signing operations audited.
```
Jules Park: Ops, please produce attestation PDF with generated timestamp and audit-log snapshot (no PII). Dominic, can you get that in 8h?
Dominic Yu: Yes. Will include the audit-log id and a redacted snapshot.
legal-sig: Drafting limited indemnity clause now. Proposing text: "Publisher will indemnify Marketplace for direct damages resulting from knowingly malicious firmware signed with Publisher keys, up to $X and subject to standard exclusions." Will route for review.
Marketplace-Reviewer: We prefer a two-tier limit: higher for intentional/knowing acts, lower for negligence. We can discuss numbers in intake form.
Sophie Tran: We'll propose a two-tier cap. Legal, add a clause that escrow is an alternative remedy if marketplace requires live verification.
Jules Park: Timeline: reviewer needs inbound bundle in 4 business days. Action owners:
- Dominic Yu: KMS attestation PDF + code-signing cert chain upload to manifest (due 8h)
- Sophie Tran: coordinate indemnity language with legal + partner (due 24h)
- legal-sig: draft indemnity and escrow template (due EOD)
- evidence-bot: generate presign manifest links when files are uploaded
- NimbusSI contact: confirm whether they will accept no-escrow attestation or require local escrow (due 48h)

Dominic Yu: Uploaded code-signing-chain.pem and kms-statement.pdf to manifest ch-escrow-1912345555. Audit snapshot ID: audit-2026-06-01-33 (redacted).
evidence-bot: Presigned URLs created. TTLs as in manifest.
legal-sig: Indemnity + escrow template drafted. Routing to Sophie and NimbusSI for sign-off. Also adding an explicit limitation: Redwood will not accept escrow where it requires private key export outside FIPS-validated HSM.
Sophie Tran: NimbusSI prefers not to have Redwood do escrow. They'll request marketplace to accept a notarized HSM attestation + remote verification window. I'll coordinate with their legal.
Marketplace-Reviewer: If you can provide remote HSM attestation + a scheduled live verification session, that may suffice for our compliance gate. We'll request a 30-minute secure session.
Jules Park: Good. Schedule live session if NimbusSI doesn't accept no-escrow. In parallel, get indemnity signed. Keep manifest TTLs short.
Dominic Yu: Uploaded pen-exec-summary.pdf (redacted) and indemnity-clause-draft.pdf (for review).
legal-sig: Reviewed indemnity redlines from NimbusSI; made language mutual-limited for third-party SI components. Re-routing for signatures.
Sophie Tran: Once legal signs, evidence-bot, share manifest with marketplace reviewer and NimbusSI.
Marketplace-Reviewer: Received manifest. Reviewing now. May request live session for HSM attestation.
Jules Park: Thanks all. We'll track this as part of the Marketplace listings epic and add templates for indemnity + escrow to our partnership-runbook. Post any blocker here. :thumbsup:
